title: One pingcli command, from the browser to the PingOne management API
lede: {{castAdmin}} picks one of 14 allow-listed commands. The lab starts pingcli with fixed arguments and a private worker profile; pingcli gets a token once, then reads {{castEnvName}} through the management API. In Mock the last two hops are simulated.

steps.title: Pick a command
steps.what: The page sends only a key. Anything that is not one of the 14 keys is refused with 400 before a process starts.

steps.title: A private profile
steps.what: The lab writes a worker client-credentials profile into a fresh private folder and points pingcli's HOME there. The secret never leaves that file.

steps.title: Start pingcli
steps.what: No shell and fixed arguments: execFile-style spawn with a minimal environment, a timeout and an output cap.

steps.title: Authenticate once
steps.what: pingcli pingone auth login gets a worker token with client credentials and stores it under the private HOME. Mock simulates this hop.

steps.title: Read the environment
steps.what: pingcli pingone api calls the management API and prints its JSON under data._embedded. Mock plays canned JSON for {{castOrg}}.

steps.title: Stream it back
steps.what: Output streams to the page as server-sent events, scrubbed of the secret and client id, then the page turns it into a table.
